PRE-LAUNCH PREVIEW · CONTENT & INTEGRATIONS IN REVIEW
Public Relations and Creator Campaigns

Put your story in the right conversations.

Connect a clear brand story with relevant journalists, creators and communities through focused outreach and coordinated campaign briefs.

The problem behind the brief.

Visibility without relevance rarely builds trust. Outreach needs a story that fits the audience and clear expectations for everyone involved.

Our approach

Develop the story, research suitable media or creators and coordinate outreach, approvals and follow-up. Keep paid placements distinct from earned coverage.

What we deliver.

PR strategy and story-angle development

Press releases and media-kit preparation

Relevant media research and outreach

Launch, event and media-buying coordination

Influencer and creator identification

Creator briefs, outreach and campaign coordination

Disclosure, approvals and usage-rights planning

Coverage and referral reporting

Tools, chosen for the job

Media briefs · creator campaign plans · coverage tracking

Final stack depends on your systems, requirements and budget.

Measurement

Relevant coverage · referral traffic · campaign engagement

Baselines and targets are agreed during discovery.

Good questions.

What is included in the engagement?

Earned media coverage is not guaranteed. Creator fees, paid placements, event costs and usage rights require an agreed scope and client approval.

How do we get started?

Share your business goal, current channels and constraints. We agree the deliverables, responsibilities, budget and schedule before work begins.

How will progress be measured?

We agree a baseline and a reporting rhythm around relevant coverage · referral traffic · campaign engagement. Targets follow discovery and the agreed scope; results are not guaranteed.
